$comment: Coding/git family detection registry (alpha.48 I-S2). Git argv is read-only (no hooks, no fsmonitor, no optional locks, no prompt, no transport, no user/system config; LC_ALL=C keeps answers stable), as the git-patch and host-shell adapters run Git. Coding-CLI ids and executables come from the native CLI registry; sign-in files from the native connection catalog (stat only).

firstCommit.$comment: alpha.56 U4-1c coding.first-commit@1 (U3U4U7 §3.8). Plumbing runs in the person's own Git config and identity, never the detection env above; the git prefix stays (no hooks, no fsmonitor). These variables are removed from the person's environment so the observed repository, index and config are the real ones, then the safety variables are set. Secret file names and content shapes come from the shared credential-path and redaction registries, not from here; bytes bounds every file read: the default selection (files under fileBytes), the content scan of the rest and any file the person ticks. The scan and the card bind the form Git stores: a file with a filter, working-tree-encoding or ident attribute, or with a CR byte, is converted by Git from the read buffer into a private object directory and read back (preview and apply); only a form equal to the scanned one is written to the repository, without filters, as is every other file. A refused form never reaches the repository's objects. Never a later read of the work tree.
